newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC eyes higher French wheat exports to Italy.
newsitem.headline: ONIC eyes higher French wheat exports to Italy.

text.p: France may benefit from quality problems affecting German soft wheat and increase its own exports to Italy by some 200,000 tonnes in the new 1996/97 season, the French grain office ONIC said on Wednesday.
Italy is the top destination for French wheat in the European Union.
"Exports to Italy should increase by 200,000 tonnes, in part because there will be less German wheat around due to quality problems," director general Alain Moulinier said at a news conference.
France is hoping to export some 2.4 million tonnes of soft wheat to Italy in 1996/97 against 2.2 million tonnes in 1995/96.
France is also targeting the export of 450,000 tonnes of maize, 300,000 tonnes of barley and about 260,000 tonnes of durum wheat to Italy this season.
ONIC officials and French grain industry operators will travel to Italy next week to meet with potential buyers including Italian traders, millers and animal feed buyers, Moulinier said.
ONIC expects French soft wheat exports to the rest of the European Union to decline in 1996/97 to 8.0 million tonnes from 8.613 million in 1995/96, mostly due to lower wheat sales to Spain.
